mentions.name: Swish Finance
mentions.description: Swish Finance provides minimalistic, simple stock widgets for the PC desktop that passively display a user's portfolio, so holdings are visible at a glance without making a conscious effort to check them.
mentions.problem: Checking a stock portfolio requires a deliberate, conscious effort; there was no passive way to keep it visible on the desktop.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building https://swishfinance.app - minimalistic and simple stock widgets for your PC. That way I no longer have to make a conscious effort to check my portfolio — it's just there on my desktop.

evidence.value: I'm building https://swishfinance.app - minimalistic and simple stock widgets for your PC. That way I no longer have to make a conscious effort to check my portfolio — it's just there on my desktop.
